title: FishFishFishFishFish
description:
FishFishFishFishFish is a casual fishing game where you cast hooks into a screen full of swimming fish, reel in your catches, and use the coins you earn to upgrade your gear.

 Watch each fish's movement and depth, gradually improve your line length, hook performance, lure effects, and more, then aim for bigger and rarer catches. The fish you catch are recorded in your library, and the species you encounter change depending on the area and weather. 

Even short play sessions steadily build progress, giving every next cast a little more excitement. With Twitch integration, fish and ships carrying viewer names can appear in the game, adding energy to fishing during streams.

 Whether you want to relax or efficiently push your upgrades forward, this is a game that lets you head out to sea at your own pace.
description_short: A casual fishing game where you catch fish swimming across the screen and upgrade your hooks and fishing line with coins. Fill your library, discover fish that change by area and weather, and enjoy fishing that grows little by little even in short sessions, all at your own pace.
